verdict.rationale: The IRS documents its own machine-to-machine channels: Modernized e-File, an XML system-to-system transmission rail, and IRIS Application to Application (A2A) intake for information returns. Both are credentialed rails, not public APIs. MeF requires Authorized e-file Provider enrollment (up to 45 days, possibly fingerprinting), A2A is gated by a Transmitter Control Code, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: openly accessible public API, published API reference/OpenAPI spec, coverage beyond filing (EIN, accounts, payments), self-serve developer credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
